notes: SECURING YOUR ACCOUNT ACTUALLY WORKS NOW. 'Secure my account' was quietly doing nothing -- it said saved, but the email was never really attached, so you could never sign in with it on any device. It genuinely works now: add an email and you can log back in anywhere and find your name, coins, chests and friends waiting. It keeps the SAME account, so nothing is copied and nothing is left behind. You also get a clear answer now when an email is already registered, instead of a silent failure.
